Clan rules
- To all the current members

1. Act as friendly as possible towards other clans and especially towards clan members. Do NOT start flaming/shaming for no apparent reason. (wrong behavior may get you kicked)
2. Just because you're in a clan, that doesn't mean you have to be constantly doing clan wars. Nonetheless you are free to do clan wars as much as you want as long as you take every one of those matches seriously.
3. Avoid to do clan wars when you think the lag will be a problem.
4. In case of important clan wars (such as tournament ones), there WILL be required communication through voice chat. (something regarding this will be updated later on).
5. Check the Clan Notice Board for more tips regarding clan wars.
6. Come to the clan thread at least once per week, there might be news regarding events or new appliers.
7. Do not go inactive for long amounts of time without any warning.
8. People who leave the guild will NOT be accepted back without a good reason to why they left.

- To all new members
Abuse of any of these rules etc. will result in warning/kick, depending on how serious it is.

1. Try being familiar with all clan members.
2. Respect other guild members. (also people outside the guild)
3. Learn team tactics and strategies from our more experienced players. You can even ask them for 1 vs. 1 and such as long as you can see those matches as practice only without any flaming/crying involved.
4. Respect each other, go to Sinyx if you got any problems.
5. Do not trash talk etc other members.

How to join

First of all, you will need quite some patience and an excellent attitude, if you're wanting to join this clan.
Next thing you do is tell one of the members you're interested in joining the clan. They will inform Sinyx about you wanting to join.
Over the next few days you should try and play as many games as possible with members of Primitive, since we want to make sure your attitude is ok to join us. (If it turns out a jerk has joined the clan he/she will be removed ASAP from the clan.)

After you've collected a total of seven vouches you have to inform Sinyx, about who is willing to vouch for you. The vouches will be checked, and the opinions of other active members will be asked as well.
After that has been taken care of, Sinyx will check your apply and make a final decission. Do note that people won't just hand out a vouch, they'll need to give the leader a decent explanation why they are willing to vouch for you. Just because you play with fellow members, does not necessarily mean they will vouch for you.

Once Sinyx made his final decission he will inform you if you're eligible to send an application and be a part of our lovely family.

Diplomacy

Primitive is not planning on becoming an ally or an enemy of another guild.
Don't bother asking for an alliance with us.

Do not send random applications, they will be ignored.
Do not spam members about playing with them. Members won't be too keen to give their vouch if they are begged or bombarded with PMs.
Note: DO NOT copy the structure of the thread or the writings without Sinyx's permission.
